Source: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1737532
Access: readable in browser on2026-10-06T19:10:50.939Z.

Bug opened because unnamed text/calendar inside multipart/alternative was absent from messages.getFull(). Earlier MIME display parsing could return a generated HTML invitation rather than original iCalendar. Later MIME parser work fixed the extraction (bugs1878620 and1854684); this landing reopens the issue for regression coverage, including the text/calendar body. The issue records the fix confirmation and test addition. No runtime test was run in this study.
